mapping(address => uint256) balances : token balances, mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed : allowance table, mutated by approve and transferFrom
uint256 totalSupply_ : total token supply, set once in constructor and read by totalSupply()
constructor(uint256 total) : mints the whole supply to msg.sender
totalSupply() view returns totalSupply_
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address receiver, uint256 numTokens) : moves tokens from msg.sender, guarded by require(numTokens <= balances[msg.sender])
approve(address delegate, uint256 numTokens) : sets allowed[msg.sender][delegate]
allowance(address owner, address delegate) view returns allowed[owner][delegate]
transferFrom(address owner, address buyer, uint256 numTokens) : spends allowance of msg.sender, guarded by balances[owner] and allowed[owner][msg.sender] checks
SafeMath.fxpMul(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 base) : returns div(mul(a,b), base)
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) : arithmetic helper with overflow require
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) : arithmetic helper with underflow require
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) : arithmetic helper with overflow require
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) : arithmetic helper with division-by-zero require
msg.sender : caller-controlled address used as account key in constructor, transfer, approve and transferFrom
transfer state arithmetic : balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens); balances[receiver] = balances[receiver].add(numTokens)
allowance write : allowed[msg.sender][delegate] = numTokens (no zero-allowance race protection)
transferFrom state arithmetic : balances[owner].sub(numTokens), allowed[owner][msg.sender].sub(numTokens), balances[buyer].add(numTokens)
raw unchecked addition uint256 c = a + b inside SafeMath.add, later validated by require(c >= a)
raw unchecked subtraction uint256 c = a - b inside SafeMath.sub, later validated by require(b <= a)
raw unchecked multiplication uint256 c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul, later validated by require(c / a == b)
raw division uint256 c = a / b inside SafeMath.div, guarded by require(b > 0)
